title: Selective Recognition of Oncogene Promoter C-Myc G-Quadruplex: Design, Synthesis, and In Vitro Evaluation of Naphthalimide and Imidazo[1,2-a]pyrazines for Their Anticancer Activity.
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成靶向c-Myc启动子G-四链体DNA的小分子配体，通过分子对接和生物物理实验研究其与G4 DNA的互作，虽涉及蛋白-DNA相关癌基因体系但非TF-DNA结合建模，方法以实验为主、仅含简单对接，故为中档。
abstract: c-Myc is a transcription factor that is overexpressed in most human cancers. Despite its challenging nature, we have developed a series of naphthalimide-imidazopyrazine conjugates to target c-Myc. The library of synthesized derivatives was tested for their anticancer activity against a nine-panel of cancer cell lines. Compound 8eb showed excellent cytotoxicity against all the tested cancer cell lines, with the range of growth inhibition from -98.79% to 96.62% at a single-dose concentration of 10(-5) M. Further, 8eb was employed for a 5-dose assay against the same cancer cell lines, which showed efficacy at varying concentrations with an MG-MID GI(50) value of 2.61 muM. Biophysical studies were performed to explore the interaction of 8eb with c-Myc Pu27 over ct-DNA, oncogene promotor Pu22, and human telomere, with a binding constant value of 1.3 x 10(7) M(-1). Additionally, experiments were performed to get insights into the interaction mechanism between 8eb and the c-Myc oncogene promoter. A molecular docking study unveiled the stacking of the compound with G4 DNA through groove binding, where very few reports are available, with a favorable binding energy of -9.2 kcal/mol. Moreover, the pharmacokinetic study and HOMO-LUMO energy gap analysis underscored the potency of the active candidate. The compound's binding ability toward HSA was also assessed, where results suggested effective binding of the compound to HSA, revealing its potential for easy delivery to the target site. The above findings suggested that these newly synthesized candidates with potent anticancer activity offer a promising avenue as G4 DNA c-Myc stabilizers.
abstract_zh: c-Myc是一种转录因子，在大多数人类癌症中过度表达。尽管其具有挑战性，我们已开发了一系列萘酰亚胺-咪唑并吡嗪偶联物来靶向c-Myc。合成的衍生物库针对九组癌细胞系进行了抗癌活性测试。化合物8eb对所有测试的癌细胞系表现出优异的细胞毒性，在单剂量浓度10(-5) M下，生长抑制范围从-98.79%到96.62%。进一步，8eb被用于针对相同癌细胞系的5剂量测定，显示出在不同浓度下的有效性，其MG-MID GI(50)值为2.61 μM。进行了生物物理研究以探索8eb与c-Myc Pu27相对于ct-DNA、癌基因启动子Pu22和人端粒的相互作用，结合常数值为1.3 x 10(7) M(-1)。此外，进行了实验以深入了解8eb与c-Myc癌基因启动子之间的相互作用机制。分子对接研究揭示了该化合物通过沟槽结合与G4 DNA堆叠，其中可用报告很少，结合能为-9.2 kcal/mol，较为有利。此外，药代动力学研究和HOMO-LUMO能隙分析强调了活性候选物的效力。还评估了该化合物对HSA的结合能力，结果表明该化合物能有效结合HSA，揭示其易于递送至靶位点的潜力。上述发现表明，这些新合成的具有强效抗癌活性的候选物为G4 DNA c-Myc稳定剂提供了有前景的途径。
